attribution: Road centrelines: Natural Earth 10m cultural vectors (public domain), which carry no names over India; each route is the course the source holds between the places listed in this folder. Numbers and facts checked against the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and Wikipedia.
_join: The source has geometry but no names, so an item lists the places its route is known by and the build walks the source's own parts between them.
_rank: 1 is a trunk route drawn widest, 3 a short one drawn finest; the engine reads rank, never a road's number.
